Ella Chen: Quick announcement — a short-term leadership rotation and a hire update for capacity/runtime teams. TL;DR: Samir and Maya will swap focused org duties for ~6 months to share operational context; we also hired a Head of Observability (start date next month).
Samir Rao: Happy to share more — i'll be pairing with runtime infra on Monday to hand over night ops runbook.
Maya Lin: Excited — will spend next 2 weeks shadowing capacity team leads and learning autoscale configs.
Aisha K.: New hire intro: please welcome Rowan Park as Head of Observability. Rowan joins 5/4 and will be working with eng-sre and runtime to centralize traces/alerts.
Tom Becker: Big +1. This rotation is to reduce single-person knowledge risk and speed cross-team runbooks. Please respect the 6-month horizon and treat this as a learning-first swap, not a permanent move.
Samir Rao: Notes for handoff: i'll publish the Capacity runbook here by EOD Fri. It includes: 
```
- current autoscale policies
- burst capacity playbook
- oncall rota and escalation matrix
```
Maya Lin: I'll be updating the runtime onboarding checklist to include capacity-specific configs and a quickstart for testing burst scenarios.
Ella Chen: Hiring/backfill note: Samir's IC mentor role will be backfilled by a temporary Senior Capacity PM (contract) — recruiting team is sourcing candidates; will post interviews calendar soon.
Aisha K.: Rowan's bio (short): ex-Observability lead @AuroraCloud, 8 yrs infra + SRE, focused on open telemetry and noise reduction. Office = NYC, hybrid.
Samir Rao: Practical ask — if you own any custom autoscale scripts, drop links here so Maya and Rowan can review. @Maya Lin @Rowan Park
Maya Lin: Will do. also scheduling 1:1s with each capacity lead next week.
Tom Becker: Please document decisions in RFCs where applicable. If there are policy changes (e.g., alert thresholds), tag me and eng-sre.
jen-bot: Reminder: New-hire equipment request for Rowan has been submitted. ETA approval: 48h. :package:
Ella Chen: Thanks all — we'll run a 30-min sync next Wed 10am PT to align shadowing schedule and onboarding tasks. Calendar invite sent. :calendar:
